note: Small working century farm east of Branson with seven RV sites around its horse barn in open pasture, plus a barn lodging rental, private trails to a spring-fed creek and waterfall, and riding lessons and trail rides offered separately. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $49.50 (site 1 booking calendar, now manual), 7 level FHU 50 A sites, online booking 12 months out. Public nightly sales yes; Google 5.0/44; Branson gateway 7 km (price under $50 anyway). Five long-stay tests pass. Not waterfront confirmed (sites in open pasture, no creek within ~150 m). Pin is on the driveway 95 m E of the barn - move to the barn.
flags: PRIVATE CHECKS: price $49.50 under the $50 gate (also Branson gateway 7 km). Presence: own booking site + phone 417-294-1226 (matches stored; site says 'Call or text us at 417-294-1226') + Google 'Homestead Farm Retreat & RV' 5.0 (44 reviews, read 2026-11-09; the site's Trustindex widget shows 5.0/45). Website https://homesteadretreatrv.com/ is this park (address 261 Collins Rd on the stored note, Google pin 36.68036,-93.15064 = stored pin). Sells nights to the public: per-site online calendar, open nights priced individually. Long-stay tests: no weekly/monthly/seasonal rate, no age or rig rule, no residents or seasonal language; one date block reads 'OMMA BLUEGRASS CAMP ATTENDEES ONLY' (an event hold) - passes; no occupancy check needed.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront, confirmed): the sites are on the gravel apron around the horse barn in open pasture; the 'spring-fed creek and waterfall' are reached by the private trails and are not visible within ~150 m of the barn in imagery (nearest wooded draw ~150 m N); a small farm pond ~90 m S is a stock pond, not a water body for the gate.
